name: detection-signals
title_zh: 给反克劳德项目增删改查中国用户检测信号
tagline_zh: 浏览器扫描、/api/check 权重、打分器，一处改全链路生效。改完不用翻代码，直接看信号怎么被算出来。
tagline_en: Tweak browser scans, /api/check weights, and scorers in one place—see exactly how each signal gets scored without.
desc_en: Add, adjust or remove "China user" detection signals in the FuckClaude project (browser scan + /api/check). Use when adding detection methods, changing signal weights or scorers, or when the user mentions 检测信号 / 检测手段 / 新增检测 / signals / weights / detectors.
why_zh: 把分散的检测逻辑收敛成信号字典，改权重像调参数，加新检测手段只需注册，不用碰主流程。
why_en: Consolidates scattered detection logic into a signal dictionary—tune weights like config, register new detectors without.
limit_zh: 只作用于 FuckClaude 仓库内的检测信号定义与权重；不负责绕过检测、不生成新检测算法，只改已有信号的增删改查。
limit_en: Only edits signal definitions/weights inside the FuckClaude repo; won't bypass detection or invent new algorithms—stops working outside this codebase.
